name: Gros Morne National Park
description: Gros Morne National Park sits on Newfoundland's west coast in Canada, covering about 1,805 square kilometres. Here, rock from deep beneath the ocean floor and the Earth's mantle lies exposed, a rare window into continental drift. Glaciers then carved fjords, sheer cliffs, waterfalls and clear lakes below the park's namesake 806-metre peak.
